bodyMarkdown:
## What Is the Alex Johnston Salary?

If you have come across the phrase "alex johnston salary" while researching pay rates, you are likely looking for a straightforward way to convert an hourly wage into an annual figure. The calculation is the same for any hourly rate: multiply by the hours worked per week and then by 52 weeks. For a full-time employee working 38 ordinary hours per week, the formula is:

**Annual gross pay = hourly rate × 38 × 52**

For example, at the current National Minimum Wage of $26.44 per hour, the alex johnston salary would be $26.44 × 38 × 52 = $52,254.40 per year. This figure is before tax, the Medicare levy, and superannuation.

## National Minimum Wage and Award Rates

From 1 July 2026, the Fair Work Commission set the National Minimum Wage at $26.44 per hour, or $1,004.90 for a 38-hour week. This applies to award/agreement-free employees. Most employees, however, are covered by a modern award, which may provide higher minimum rates. The Fair Work Ombudsman publishes [pay guides](/blog) that list the minimum pay rates for each award, including allowances and penalty rates. Award wages increased by 4.75% from 1 July 2026, as noted by the Fair Work Ombudsman.

### Casual Loading

Casual employees receive a 25% loading on top of the base rate. For the National Minimum Wage, that means $33.05 per hour. When using [the timesheet](/), you can check a box to add the casual loading. Never enter a rate that already includes the loading; the tool adds it for you.

## The Fortnightly View

It can be helpful to think in fortnightly terms, especially if you are paid every two weeks. Multiply the weekly pay by two. For the alex johnston salary at the minimum wage:

- Weekly: $1,004.90
- Fortnightly: $2,009.80

This makes budgeting easier and aligns with many employers' pay cycles.

## Tax and the Medicare Levy

The Australian Taxation Office uses a progressive tax scale for residents in 2026–27:

- Nil on the first $18,200
- 15% on income from $18,201 to $45,000
- 30% on income from $45,001 to $135,000
- 37% on income from $135,001 to $190,000
- 45% on income above $190,000

In addition, the Medicare levy is generally 2% of your taxable income. For the alex johnston salary of $52,254, the tax would be approximately $5,092 plus $1,045 Medicare levy, leaving about $46,117 after those deductions. This is an estimate; your actual tax may vary based on offsets, deductions, and the Medicare levy surcharge if applicable.

## Superannuation Paid on Top

Employers must pay superannuation guarantee contributions of 12% of your ordinary time earnings. This is on top of your salary, not deducted from it. For the alex johnston salary, the super contribution would be $6,270.40 per year, up to the maximum contribution base of $270,830. Super is not included in the annual salary figure shown on [the timesheet](/).

## Using the Timesheet for Your Own Rate

Whether you are checking the alex johnston salary or your own hourly rate, the [the timesheet](/) lets you enter your base hourly rate and see the annual, monthly, fortnightly, and weekly equivalents. It also shows estimated tax and super. Remember that the tool assumes 38 hours per week, no unpaid overtime, no penalty rates, and no salary sacrifice. For award-covered employees, always check the specific [pay guides](/blog) for your classification.

## Distinguishing the Different Pay Concepts

- **National Minimum Wage**: The legal floor for award/agreement-free employees.
- **Award rates**: Higher minimums set by the Fair Work Commission for specific industries.
- **Casual loading**: An extra 25% for casual employees.
- **Super**: 12% paid on top by the employer.

When you see "alex johnston salary," it is simply an example of applying the hourly-to-annual conversion. The same method works for any hourly rate.

## Reference Tables and Further Reading

For more detailed pay data, including historical rates and award classifications, visit the [reference tables](/data) page. You can also explore [average pay](/topics/average-pay) figures from the Australian Bureau of Statistics, such as full-time adult ordinary time earnings of $2,083.70 per week (May 2026).

## Disclaimer

Annual pay here is hourly rate × hours per week × 52. It assumes the same rate every week, no unpaid overtime, no penalty rates, no allowances, and no salary sacrifice. Super is estimated at 12% of ordinary earnings only, paid on top, and stops at the $270,830 maximum contribution base. Tax is the 2026–27 resident scale with the full tax-free threshold. Medicare uses the 2025–26 single reduction thresholds because the 2026–27 reduction thresholds were not confirmed here. HELP, the Medicare levy surcharge, and salary packaging are not deducted. This is an estimate, not a determination of your pay or tax.
